captions.detailed: A classic two-link desk lamp consisting of a heavy, circular black base, two parallel silver-colored metal arms with tension springs, and a black dome-shaped lamp shade. The lower arm rotates on a hinge at the base, the upper arm articulates via a central elbow hinge, and the lamp shade tilts on a knuckle joint at the top. A small toggle switch is mounted on the rear of the shade assembly.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a classic two-link desk lamp with a circular base, dual-bar spring-loaded arms, a dome-shaped shade, and a rear toggle switch. Ensure all joints are properly articulated to allow rotation at the base, elbow, shade knuckle, and switch pivot.
captions.factory: Construct the lamp using an ArticulatedObject builder. Build the base using a cylinder, adding a small vertical post and hinge bracket. Model the lower and upper links using pairs of parallel rectangular bars, transverse crossbars, and helical spring representations. Create the lamp shade by revolving a dome profile and hollow it out. Define revolute joints for the base pivot, the elbow connector, the shade attachment, and the toggle switch.
